final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and instead narrowed the certification theory using the same record. That reframing is directionally more accurate than an unqualified compliance claim, but it still does not satisfy the policy requirement that certification may proceed only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material segment weakness is disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. The available evidence still shows a current student aid advising regression, no attached reviewed mitigation or approved risk acceptance, and no current model card or equivalent certification document containing the required disclosure. That means the caveat is not merely explanatory; it is an unresolved compliance predicate. Aggregate readiness clearing by 2.2 points and the absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support launch-readiness context, but they do not establish policy compliance on the present record.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence shows that the current release documentation reflects the current evaluation results.
No new admissible evidence provides the actual disclosure language for the student aid advising weakness in the current release documentation.
No approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance for the current release has been produced.
The student aid advising regression remains material to a named launch use case and is not cured by aggregate readiness results alone.
Prior approval and the informal monitoring comment remain contextual only and do not satisfy the policy predicates for certification.
